description: Fork of exp333. Keeps partition_sets on out_proj. Reshapes out_proj to the opposite extreme from exp334: very large table_dim (2^12=4096) with few tables (tph=64) and few output votes (onap=8). Same total out_proj bit-param budget (~2.1M/layer, 13M total) as exp333/334, redistributed into per-table discrete-state capacity. Tests whether the regression comes from lookup granularity (big entries help) or table count.
